name: Fort Dundas
scope: Historical reconstruction of the principal 1824 Fort Dundas timber enclosure, paired officers’ ranges, dry ditch and associated shore-side sheds on Barlow Point, Melville Island.
era: Early establishment in November 1824, before the storm of April 1827.

externalReferences.artist: John Septimus Roe (survey and field sketch)

originalReview.notes: The published foldout records the early crest enclosure from Garden Point. Its drawing shows the paired quarters behind the timber fence and two thatched roofs at lower elevation on the shore side.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Checked the Qualla story first. The original contains no published photographs or drawings. Used the original 1827 Natural History Museum Library foldout from the contemporary survey by John Septimus Roe.
